jobs.description: Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.Casualty Risk Consulting (CRC) is a center of expertise providing technical and scientific services with a (re)insurance background in connection with complex and highly exposed liability risks. CRC's globally recognized services are tailored to the situation and the customer's needs. Our clients are the underwriters (facultative, treaty, direct) and client managers at Munich Re as well as ceding companies. We are looking for an experienced consultant who is able to analyze and evaluate a variety of liability risks, but with a strong focus on mining, oil and gas, utilities and petrochemical industries.Your Job- Assessing complex liability risks, including guiding and supporting the evaluation and management of these risks, depending on the cover provided (single risks, risk categories, or portfolios/treaties)- Evaluating cedents' risk-management activities - risk selection, pricing, risk assessment - also by participating in Underwriting audits- Screening developments in the relevant fields of expertise to detect and report on interesting trends and emerging risks, internally and externally.- Constantly improving, adapting and newly developing services in line with potentially changing client needs or a changing environment (technical, legal) in the respective field of expertise- Speaking/presenting at international seminars, meetings, and congresses, conveying Munich Re's distinct expertise, participating in or leading publications and workgroups- Carrying out site inspections or participating in meetings to develop recommendations for risk improvement or improved risk management (for cedents or insureds)Your Profile- University degree in an engineering or natural science discipline relevant to the industries mentioned above- Very good knowledge of general liability and environmental liability (risk assessment and cover) with more than 5 years of work experience in the assessment of those risks in at least one of the above mentioned industries- Outstanding analytical skills, ability to familiarize yourself with new topics quickly- Affinity for legal topics; good judgement and common sense- Business-fluent in English and German; additional languages are a plus- High degree of service orientation; pronounced intercultural skills- Strong social skills and ability to work in a team- Clear, well-structured, and easily comprehensible communication, even on very complex topics; good presentation skills- Willingness to travelApplication InstructionsPlease apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.About usAs the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.Unlock your potential- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.Rewards & Recognition- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.Münchener Rückversicherungs-GesellschaftLeonie JohnsonTalent Acquisition PartnerErgänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Risikomanagement, Risikocontrolling, Evaluation

Mission Brief The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements.The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.Your Role in Our Space Mission: - Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies.- Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions.- Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks.- Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations.- Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence.- Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations.- Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand.- Develop and maintain inspector training, qualification, certification, and recertification requirements.- Partner with Manufacturing, Production Engineering, Product Assurance, and Supplier Quality to resolve conformity concerns and improve product quality.- Provide clear conformity recommendations and inspection performance reporting to senior leadership.Qualification Checklist - Extensive experience in manufacturing quality, inspection, product assurance, or quality engineering leadership roles.- Demonstrated expertise in inspection methods, conformity assessment, acceptance criteria, and verification planning.- Strong understanding of incoming inspection, in-process inspection, final inspection, and release processes.- Experience leading NDT disciplines including X-Ray, Computed Tomography (CT), Ultrasonic, and Dye Penetrant inspection.- Knowledge of laboratory operations, materials testing, metallography, calibration systems, and failure analysis methods.- Experience developing inspection standards, procedures, governance models, and competency frameworks.- Ability to make objective conformity decisions based on technical evidence and risk assessment.- Strong leadership capability with experience developing and managing multidisciplinary technical teams.- Proven ability to implement scalable quality systems within fast-growing manufacturing organizations.- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.- Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and commitment to product integrity.- Professional proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.Aim high, deliver relentlessly, act with integrity, and keep the mission first.Benefits - Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program- 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge- Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period- Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day- Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance- Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  - Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)- Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period- Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children- And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Fertigungstechnik, Qualitätsmanagement

jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application Deadline: December 2, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.occupation: Teleoperator (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR [BA/JC] (Maschinen- und Anlagenführer/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Robotics Experte; Fernsteuerer/in (Robotik); Roboterbediener/in; KI-Trainer/inStellenbeschreibung:DeutschBerufsbezeichnung: Teleoperator / Teleoperatorin (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR (Praktikum mit Option auf Festanstellung)Über unsWir entwickeln die Technologie, mit der Roboter in der echten Welt sehen, verstehen und handeln können – in Lagern und Fabriken, nicht im Labor. Unsere Mission: die Lücken schließen, an denen klassische Automatisierung scheitert.Deine AufgabeDu steuerst Roboter über ein VR-Headset und hilfst so dabei, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Aufgaben in der echten Welt erledigt. Konkret:- Roboter per VR-Headset fernsteuern und dabei hochwertige Bewegungsdaten erzeugen- Bild- und Sensordaten sichten und mit hoher Sorgfalt kennzeichnen (Labeling)- Einfache, vorgegebene Abläufe am PC ausführen (wir zeigen dir genau, wie)- Auffälligkeiten dokumentieren: was ist passiert, was hättest du erwartet, wann genau- Enger Austausch mit einem kleinen, eingespielten TeamWas du mitbringen solltest- Keine Vorerfahrung nötig – wir bringen dir alles bei, was du für den Job brauchst- Gute Deutsch- oder gute Englischkenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)- Ruhige Hand, gutes Auge fürs Detail und Geduld bei sich wiederholenden Aufgaben- Grundlegende PC-Kenntnisse (E-Mails schreiben, Dateien verwalten reicht völlig)- Lust, dich in eine neue, ungewöhnliche Tätigkeit einzuarbeiten- Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und gutes Reaktionsvermögen sind hilfreich – wer gern zockt, bringt hier oft schon ein gutes Gespür für Steuerung und Timing mit- Zuverlässigkeit und pünktliches ErscheinenWo und wieStuttgart-Vaihingen, vor Ort (kein Homeoffice möglich, da mit der Technik vor Ort gearbeitet wird).Art der Stelle & VerdienstStart als Praktikum, max. 6 Monate, Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche), 2.500 € brutto/Monat. Nach erfolgreichem Praktikum ist ein Einstieg in eine Festanstellung möglich, mit Verdienstmöglichkeiten von bis zu 65.000 € brutto/Jahr, abhängig von Erfahrung und Übernahme von Verantwortung.BewerbungBitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht nötig – schreib uns stattdessen kurz, warum du Lust auf die Stelle hast.Unser Ablauf1. Bewerbung (Lebenslauf + kurze Nachricht)2. Schnuppertag vor Ort: Du lernst das Team kennen und bearbeitest gemeinsam eine reale Aufgabe aus dem Arbeitsalltag, um ein echtes Gefühl für die Stelle zu bekommenEnglishJob title: Teleoperator (m/f/d) – Robot Control via VR (Internship with option to convert to full-time)Who We AreWe build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world – moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve.Your RoleYou'll control robots through a VR headset, helping teach them how to carry out real-world tasks. Specifically:- Operate robots via a VR headset to generate high-quality movement data- Review and label visual and sensor data with care and precision- Carry out simple, well-defined tasks on the computer (we'll show you exactly how)- Document anything unusual: what happened, what you expected, and when- Work closely with a small, hands-on teamWhat You Should Bring- No prior experience required – we'll teach you everything you need for the job- Good German or good English skills (spoken and written)- A steady hand, good attention to detail, and patience with repetitive tasks- Basic computer skills (writing emails, managing files is plenty)- Willingness to learn a new and unusual kind of work- Good spatial awareness and reaction time are a plus – if you enjoy video games, you likely already have a feel for control and timing- Reliability and punctualityLocation & SetupStuttgart-Vaihingen, on-site (remote work isn't possible, as the role requires working with the hardware in person).Type of Role & PayStarts as an internship, max. 6 months, full-time (40 h/week), €2,500 gross/month. After a successful internship, there's an opportunity to move into a full-time position, with earning potential of up to €65,000 gross/year, depending on experience and responsibility taken on.How to ApplyPlease send us your CV. A formal cover letter isn't necessary – just tell us briefly why you're interested in the role.Our Interview Plan1. Application (CV + short message)2. On-site assessment day: meet the team and work through a real challenge similar to the day-to-day role, to get a genuine feel for the environmentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Qualitätskontrolle (einfache Kontrolltätigkeit)

jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

In addition...- ... you operate the Lufthansa City Airlines aircraft safely and efficiently- ... you act responsibly and sustainably- ... you are ready and willing to actively shape Lufthansa City AirlinesIhr Profil:In addition to your strong decision-making skills and ability to work in a team, you will need the following for this vacancy:- EASA CPL(A) / IR(A) with ATPL theory credit and MCC or MPL (Phase 4 completed)- A320/A220 Type Rating and 500h total flight hours on CS-25 aircraft- Medical Class I- Advanced UPRT training according to EASA.FCL.745- General higher education entrance qualification or equivalent qualification- EU citizenship or unrestricted residence and work permit- Passport with unlimited validity (if no EU passport is available, there must be no stricter entry restrictions than with an EU passport)- Confident oral and written language skills in English (at least ICAO Language Proficiency Level 4)Selection is based on the standards of City Airlines. Recognition of Lufthansa Group selection procedures is possible.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant Financial Processes and Intercompany (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 1616743

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.

Your role
As part of our Platform, Solutions and Intelligence Team within a European center of excellence in Stuttgart or Munich you will consult multinational clients in cross-border and complex problems. You will take on a wide variety of tasks:

- Conception and implementation of digital transformation projects with a focus on accounting and reporting processes as well as intercompany accounting within the SAP S/4HANA environment
- Consulting of the finance organization to implement efficient finance processes as well as digitalization of business processes in NextGen-ERP-systems – from strategy development, concept preparation and process design to the optimization and implementation
- Specialized consulting services in an international environment to solve complex problems in in-house accounting, interlocked with the respective logistics, controlling and accounting processes
- Involvement in the development of innovative services and preparation of turnkey solutions for clients
- Responsibilities for project progress and technical leadership of teams

Your skillset

- University degree in economics and several years of relevant experience in consulting and collaboration with substantial, complex clients; ideally with a specialization in intercompany accounting and operational transfer pricing issues
- Deep understanding of functional problems in internal and cross-border processes
- Very good application and implementation capabilities in one or more of the following technologies: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Central Finance, SAP Module FI/CO, SAP PaPM, Blackline produccts, Anaplan; Exceptional communication skills in German and English

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.  <>More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on our Careers page  .
At EY, we emb  diversity and welcome all applications. Let us know in good time if we can help you by offering an accessible application process.
Any questions? Just call +49 6196 996 10005 and our Recruitment Center will be happy to help.
